content:
**the DAG canvas and inspector drawer ship for #881**

PR 4 of the #881 chain lands the page itself: server.mjs serves static/ and lib/ through an allow-list (a literal map plus ^/lib/<module>.mjs), so the browser imports the SAME pure modules node:test imports — no bundler, no dependency, no CDN. static/index.html is four mounts and nothing else; static/app.js is wiring only, with every decision in a tested lib module: frames.mjs (the SSE reducer — sync/section/refs/status, and nothing it does can clear the page), canvas-model.mjs (layout + colour per node, the colour call wrapped PER NODE because colour.mjs throws on an unknown state by design, so one unknown state marks one node and the rest still draws), drawer-model.mjs (the four R881-8 tabs in one entry shape, a source string under every value, an unreadable review thread rendered as an entry instead of skipped) and banners.mjs (design.md's two degradation sentences verbatim, plus every {ok:false} snapshot section named). The poll ruling is rendered: a 'forge polled N s ago / paused' indicator, a control that disables polling and a button for one manual poll, both POSTing to the poller's three routes. Manual walkthrough against this repo with a real gh: 91 nodes drawn, 7 edges, 81 unlinked, 12 edges to closed issues listed in band, 67 nodes marked '? track', zero nodes falling to the unknown class; GET /api/change/881 returned Spec 10 cards, Tasks 53 rows, Working memory ok:false ('more than one feat/issue-881-* branch'), Reviews read and empty; 91 drawer leaves, none without a source. Two findings for follow-up, neither in this slice's fence: layout.mjs lays the 81 unlinked nodes in ONE row (a 16160px-wide canvas), and main()'s resolveForgeSource() reads the origin remote from process.cwd() rather than --root, so brain:ui --root <other repo> polls THIS repo's forge.
